Barratt of Ealing was an easy winner in 43.17, followed by Olney 44.13, and Ingles another minute back, third Peter Bagnall ran well to be 4th in 45.42, but he had no backing from the rest who included Short 9th, Gebbett 12th, Abbott 13th, L.

The "A" Team started quite well with Dave Baulch 9th, but Abbott, 23rd for the "B" Team, did not run nearly as well as expected. Masters then pulled the "A" Team up to 4th place but Brian Trower showed his lack of recent racing with a rather slow time which contributed greatly to our subsequent defeat.
Masters "A", Abbott "B" and Jordon "V" went off first and Dave Abbot was seen in the lead after half a mile but unfortunately fell away badly in the second half of his run.
